# mailboxorg_domains (Data Source)

Lists the domains of a mailbox.org account (`domain.list`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mailboxorg_domains" "example" {
  account = "my-account"
}

output "domain_names" {
  value = [for d in data.mailboxorg_domains.example.domains : d.domain]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) The account whose domains are listed.

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Search filter passed to the API.

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) The domains of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))
- `id` (String) The account name.

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `count_mails` (Number) Number of mail addresses defined for the domain.
- `domain` (String) The domain name.
